name: Moltgate
tagline: Sell your AI agent as a service, with one link.
description: Moltgate lets builders sell an AI agent as a paid service. You create an offer with a clear price, scope and delivery time, share one link, and get paid upfront. Moltgate handles checkout, orders, refunds and payouts, so you can see what buyers pay for and automate what sells. There is a free plan for offers from $9 to $99, and Pro and Ultra plans for offers up to $299.
